announcement: West Coast Concrete Lining — Concrete Rehabilitation • Lining • Waterproofing • Repair

feature.headline: Protecting critical infrastructure.
feature.text: Durable concrete lining, waterproofing, inspection, and repair solutions for demanding environments.

intro.headline: Specialty rehabilitation for critical infrastructure
paragraphs: WCCL Systems is a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) providing specialized concrete rehabilitation services for infrastructure exposed to water, chemicals, abrasion, and demanding service conditions.
We work with municipalities, government contractors, utilities, industrial facilities, engineers, and general contractors to protect, repair, and extend the service life of concrete structures.

services.title: Concrete Lining
services.text: Protective lining applied inside concrete shafts and structures to resist water, chemicals, abrasion, and hydrogen sulfide exposure. Raven 405 application and GU-certified manhole modifications are available.

services.title: Concrete Waterproofing
services.text: Exterior waterproofing and protective coating work that helps limit water intrusion and extend the service life of concrete tanks and structures.

services.title: Concrete Structure Repair
services.text: Concrete rehabilitation and surface repair for wastewater and utility structures, including preparation, patching, leak repair, and chemical grouting for soil or structural support.

services.title: Inspections and Testing
services.text: Field inspections and testing used to document existing conditions—including manhole vacuum tests, joint tests, and sewer-line testing—before repair or rehabilitation work begins.

services.title: HDPE Welding
services.text: HDPE fabrication and welding for large-diameter pipe, liners, manholes, and related systems. This project shows a field-fabricated HDPE structure being prepared for installation.

services.title: PVC Welding
services.text: PVC welding and fabrication for corrosion-resistant piping, fittings, liners, and custom components used in demanding utility and industrial applications.

services.title: Special Civil Services
services.text: Specialty field services including HDPE and fiberglass manhole welding, Predl repairs, GU-certified modifications, channel work, coring, testing, grouting, leak repair, and filter or coalescent-pack installation.

services.title: Manhole Channeling
services.text: Installation, modification, and rehabilitation of manhole channels to restore smooth flow, repair damaged surfaces, and improve long-term wastewater structure performance.

services.title: Floor, Coating, and Architectural Painting
services.text: Surface preparation and durable floor, concrete, and architectural coating systems for industrial, commercial, and infrastructure environments.

why.headline: Quality, safety, and dependable execution.
why.text: WCCL Systems evaluates existing conditions, coordinates closely with owners and project teams, and builds practical solutions around long-term infrastructure performance.
